player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Go fuduga go tshwanetse ga nna ka mokgwa wa [macro micro] le dinomoro tsa 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Di-index tsotlhe di tshwanetse go nna magareng ga 0 le 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, row kgotsa col ga e mo lefelong le o ka kgonang go di bona.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Sele eno e setse e tsentswe.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Motshameki o tshwanetse go tshameka mo lekaleng le lengwe la metšhine.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Boto ya go tshameka metshameko e mennye e setse e fentse.

next_board.any: boto nngwe le nngwe e nnye ya motlakase

game_action.played: Player {player_id} e ne a tshameka mo bongwana jo jo kwa ntle {macro_idx}, selo {micro_idx} (lerako {row}, koluma {col}). Player {opponent_id} a tshwanetse go tshameka mo {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Motshameki {player_id} o fenya Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
